1: // Minimal endless side‑scroll runner with simple graphics enhancements
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   // Audio setup (Web Audio API)
10:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
11:   // Simple beep generator
12:   const playBeep = (freq, dur) => {
13:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     oscillator.frequency.value = freq;
16:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
17:     oscillator.connect(gain);
18:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
21:     oscillator.start();
22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
23:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
24:   };
25: 
26:   // Resize canvas to fill its container
27:   const resize = () => {
28:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
29:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
30:     groundY = canvas.height * 0.8; // recompute ground position on resize
31:   };
32:   resize();
33:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
34: 
35:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
36:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
37:   const SPEED = 4; // world scroll speed
38: 
39:   let groundY = canvas.height * 0.8; // updated on resize
40: 
41:   const player = {
42:     x: 50,
43:     y: groundY,
44:     radius: 12,
45:     vy: 0,
46:     onGround: true,
47:     draw() {
48:       // draw a gradient circle for the player
49:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x + this.radius / 2, this.y - this.radius / 2, this.radius / 4, this.x + this.radius / 2, this.y - this.radius / 2, this.radius);
50:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#00f');
51:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#006');
52:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
53:       ctx.beginPath();
54:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y - this.radius, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
55:       ctx.fill();
56:     },
57:     update(gY) {
58:       this.vy += GRAVITY;
59:       this.y += this.vy;
60:       if (this.y >= gY) {
61:         this.y = gY;
62:         this.vy = 0;
63:         this.onGround = true;
64:       } else {
65:         this.onGround = false;
66:       }
67:     },
68:   };
69: 
70:   // simple obstacle definition
71:   const obstacles = [];
72:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
73:     const width = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
74:     const height = 20 + Math.random() * 40;
75:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width + width, y: groundY, w: width, h: height });
76:   };
77:   // spawn every ~1.5‑2 seconds
78:   setInterval(spawnObstacle, 1600);
79: 
80:   // Input: space or click triggers jump
81:   const tryJump = () => {
82:     // Ensure audio context is running (required after user gesture)
83:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
84:     if (player.onGround) {
85:       player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
86:       player.onGround = false;
87:       playBeep(600, 0.08); // jump sound
88:     }
89:   };
90:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.code === 'Space') tryJump(); });
91:   canvas.addEventListener('click', tryJump);
92: 
93:   let running = true;
94:   const gameOver = () => {
95:     running = false;
96:     // play collision sound
97:     playBeep(200, 0.3);
98:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
99:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
100:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
101:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
102:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
103:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
104:   };
105: 
106:   const checkCollision = (obj) => {
107:     // approximate player as a square bounding box based on its radius
108:     const half = player.radius;
109:     return (
110:       player.x - half < obj.x + obj.w &&
111:       player.x + half > obj.x &&
112:       player.y - half < obj.y &&
113:       player.y > obj.y - obj.h
114:     );
115:   };
116: 
117:   function loop() {
118:     if (!running) return;
119:     // clear
120:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
121:     // draw background
122:     const skyGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
123:     skyGradient.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // light sky
124:     skyGradient.addColorStop(1, '#4682B4'); // deeper sky
125:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGradient;
126:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
127: 
128:     // ground gradient
129:     const groundGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, canvas.height);
130:     groundGradient.addColorStop(0, '#8B4513');
131:     groundGradient.addColorStop(1, '#654321');
132:     ctx.fillStyle = groundGradient;
133:     ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, canvas.width, canvas.height - groundY);
134:     // update and draw player
135:     player.update();
136:     player.draw();
137:     // move obstacles
138:     // draw obstacles with gradient
139:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
140:       const o = obstacles[i];
141:       o.x -= SPEED;
142:       const obsGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y - o.h, o.x, o.y);
143:       obsGrad.addColorStop(0, '#a00'); // dark top
144:       obsGrad.addColorStop(1, '#f44'); // bright bottom
145:       ctx.fillStyle = obsGrad;
146:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y - o.h, o.w, o.h);
147:       if (checkCollision(o)) {
148:         gameOver();
149:         return;
150:       }
151:       // remove off‑screen
152:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
153:     }
154:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
155:   }
156: 
157:   loop();
158: })();
